note: dxpr_builder_block is a config-only submodule of dxpr_builder. It installs the block_content type drag_and_drop_block whose body view-display component uses the dxpr_builder_text formatter. No code, settings, permissions, schema, or Drush. Cases are grounded in the shipped block-type config: introspection reads the body formatter on block_content.drag_and_drop_block.default; execution (hard) sets that view-display component's formatter to dxpr_builder_text (verified live). NOTE: on this minimal base site the shared block_content.body field storage is text_long while the shipped drag_and_drop_block body FieldConfig is text_with_summary, so creating a drag_and_drop_block *entity* throws 'Property summary is unknown'; the hard case therefore targets the display config, which is unaffected by that data-layer mismatch.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal dxpr_builder_block submodule add when enabled?
evals.expected_output: It installs a custom block-content type 'Drag and Drop Block' (machine name drag_and_drop_block) whose body field is edited/displayed with the DXPR Builder (dxpr_builder_text) formatter, for building reusable visually-designed blocks. It is config-only.

evals.prompt: Which field formatter makes the body of the dxpr_builder_block 'Drag and Drop Block' type editable with the DXPR visual editor, and on which entity type is the block type defined?
evals.expected_output: The body field's view display uses the dxpr_builder_text formatter. The block type is a block_content bundle (drag_and_drop_block).

evals.prompt: How does dxpr_builder_block differ from dxpr_builder_page, and what would I use it for?
evals.expected_output: dxpr_builder_block provides a reusable custom block type (drag_and_drop_block on the block_content entity) for designing reusable components (heroes, CTAs) placed via Block layout, whereas dxpr_builder_page provides a full page content type (drag_and_drop_page on nodes). Both use the dxpr_builder_text formatter for their body.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the default view display of the drag_and_drop_block custom block type and state which formatter its body field uses.
evals.expected_output: The body component in core.entity_view_display.block_content.drag_and_drop_block.default uses the dxpr_builder_text formatter (DXPR Builder).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the default view display of the drag_and_drop_block custom block type so its body field is rendered/edited with DXPR Builder (rather than the plain text formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.block_content.drag_and_drop_block.default the body component has type 'dxpr_builder_text' (e.g. $vd->setComponent('body', ['type'=>'dxpr_builder_text',...])->save();).
